subject: Onboarding & Offboarding Verification Playbook and Sample Journal — SOC 2
messages:
From: SOC2 Audit <soc2-audit@auditorco.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@sentinelbank.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding/offboarding verification playbook and sample journal

Hi Lauren,

As part of Sentinel Financial's SOC 2 readiness review we need a short sampling of evidence demonstrating your onboarding and offboarding controls for personnel during the last 6 months. Specifically we are looking for: 

- The formal onboarding/offboarding playbook or runbook you follow (policies + operational steps).
- A redacted sample journal (CSV) showing entries for hires, background check completion dates, security training completions, and deprovisioning events. Please include a simple redaction map describing what was removed/hashed and the method used.

Requested scope: hires + leavers between 2026-05-01 and 2026-10-31. A 20–50 row redacted sample is fine — we do not need full PII.

Please deliver the playbook and one redacted sample by EOD Nov 9, 2026. If you have an internal doc or Drive folder we can be granted view access to, that works as well. If additional logs (Okta deprovision export, GSuite access revocations) are helpful, let us know and we can request them.

Thanks,
Maria Chen
Senior Auditor, AuditorCo
soc2-audit@auditorco.com

Thanks Maria — we can do that.

Karthik / Priya: can you pull together the current onboarding/offboarding playbook and a redacted sample journal covering 2026-05-01 through 2026-10-31? Auditor asks for 20–50 rows; redaction map and short notes on how identifiers were handled are required. Please follow these constraints:

- Hash employee identifiers (SHA256) and include a redaction_map.xlsx describing the mapping method (no key material in the sample).
- Preserve date granularity (YYYY-MM-DD) but remove PII (names/emails).
- Include columns: employee_id_hashed, role, hire_date, bg_check_date, training_module, training_status, training_completion_date, deprovision_date, deprovision_reason, last_access_revoked_at, notes.

Aim to get a draft to AuditorCo by EOD Nov 9. If you need extra logs (Okta/GCP access revocation), note that in your reply so I can open a ticket.

Karthik — I think you maintain the playbook. Priya — can you own redaction and the sample journal export + quick QA?

Lauren Bishop

Redwood Inference

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 10:03 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Maria — we can do that.
> 
> Karthik / Priya: can you pull together the current onboarding/offboarding playbook and a redacted sample journal covering 2026-05-01 through 2026-10-31? ...

Uploading first draft here and attaching a redacted sample to this thread for quick review. Summary of what I've attached: 

1) onboarding_verification_playbook_v2.pdf — the operational playbook we use for hires and leavers. Includes owner, steps, required evidence, SLA targets, and escalation flow.

2) sample_journal_redacted.csv — 50 rows exported from the HR system covering hires/leavers May–Oct 2026. Columns: employee_id_hashed (SHA256), role, hire_date, bg_check_date, training_module, training_status (completed/partial), training_completion_date, deprovision_date (if applicable), deprovision_reason, last_access_revoked_at, notes.

3) redaction_map.xlsx — short spreadsheet describing redaction rules (IDs hashed with SHA256, names removed, emails truncated to domain only where needed; no reversible mapping included).

A few operational notes: 
- Background checks are logged as completion_date in the HR system and we store the vendor reference ID in internal-only fields (not in the sample).
- Training completion is pulled from our LMS (completion timestamp). The playbook documents required modules and remediation windows.
- Deprovision events are sourced from Okta/GCP exports; I included last_access_revoked_at which is the timestamp from access logs when the last active session/token was invalidated.

If AuditorCo wants the raw Okta export as additional corroboration, say the word and we'll provision a short export.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: onboarding_verification_playbook_v2.pdf (PDF), sample_journal_redacted.csv (CSV), redaction_map.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks — I reviewed the CSV and redaction_map. A couple of quick clarifications for the auditor: 

- The employee_id_hashed column is SHA256(employee_uuid) with no salt in the sample — the redaction_map.xlsx documents the decision and points to our internal key management notes (no keys included). We used one-way hashing to avoid accidental re-identification.
- For training rows where training_status = "partial" the training_completion_date column is empty; remediation entries are in notes.
- The sample contains 50 rows (mix of hires and leavers). Date formats are YYYY-MM-DD.

Drive link (view only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefE_playbook
Internal ticket for access exports: JIRA-SEC-8345 (Okta/GCP exports pending; will provide if AuditorCo requests).

If AuditorCo is fine with this sample, I will mark the artifacts as final and add the exports to the Jira ticket for secure handoff.

Priya Natarajan

Redwood Inference
